about.title: About Us
about.desc: Polgün is a strong solution partner managing design, engineering, production, and implementation processes of waterpark projects under a single roof. With more than twenty years of industry experience, high production capacity, and international project experience, we offer reliable, innovative, and sustainable solutions for projects of all sizes.
about.power_title: A Growing Power on the International Stage
about.power_desc1: Polgün started its operations in Muğla-Menteşe in 2002. Today, it continues its activities with 4 main production centers in Muğla, offices in Istanbul and Spain, the Antalya factory established in 2022, and the new Bursa investment.
about.power_desc2: With its 120,000 m² integrated production infrastructure, fully automated machine park, and expert staff, it is one of the leading companies in the sector that can realize steel construction and polyester manufacturing under the same roof.
about.power_desc3: With 425 employees and a 30-person R&D team, Polgün manages all processes from design to production and delivers turnkey projects.
about.arge_title: Muğla's First and Only R&D Center
about.arge_desc1: As Polgün Waterparks, the foundation of our R&D approach is to develop safe, innovative, sustainable, and high-value-added water entertainment technologies. Awarded the R&D Center status by Ministry approval in 2021, our center is the first and only R&D Center in Muğla, leading the way in original product development, localization, and technology production in our industry.
about.arge_desc2: In our R&D Center, with our 30 full-time equivalent qualified R&D personnel serving as researchers, technicians, and support staff, we carry out new product design, engineering analysis, prototyping, testing, validation, production method development, and intellectual property processes with a holistic approach.
about.arge_desc3: Our innovative product projects such as Navatu, Savanna, Monarch Butterfly, and Eclipse are among the important R&D outputs representing Polgün's design, engineering, and manufacturing power in the international market.
about.misyon_desc: To bring unique solutions to the water entertainment industry by developing high-quality, safe, cost-effective, and innovative R&D projects.
about.vizyon_desc: To be a leading and pioneering R&D center shaping water entertainment technologies; to be a brand that produces technology, inspires the industry, and creates value for a sustainable future.

stats.status_desc: Ministry approved, first and only in Muğla

about.production_subtitle: From design to production, we manage all processes under one roof.
about.production_desc: Polgün realizes the solutions developed for waterparks and entertainment systems with an integrated production infrastructure combining steel construction, mechanical processing, composite production, surface applications, and digital production technologies.
about.production_power: We Reflect Our Production Power onto Our Projects.
about.production_power_desc: By managing engineering, production, and quality control processes under the same roof, we develop reliable, high-quality solutions customized for each project.

entegre_depo.title: Integrated Raw Material & Logistics Warehouse
entegre_depo.desc: Polgün manages the procurement, storage, and production dispatch processes of raw materials, auxiliary supplies, and technical equipment within its own operational structure. Systematic inventory and materials management ensures that various manufacturing units access required inputs swiftly and in a controlled manner. The coordinated execution of production, warehousing, and procurement maintains continuous manufacturing while reinforcing material traceability and operational control.

model_kalıp.title: Model & Mold Workshop
model_kalıp.desc: Polgün translates original and complex geometries into production with high precision via its 5-axis CNC model and mold manufacturing infrastructure. Managing all processes in-house from digital design to mold fabrication delivers superior surface finish, dimensional precision, and repeatable production quality. Thanks to our CNC technology, custom project designs and next-generation slide profiles are prepared for production rapidly alongside standard models.

elyaf.title: Fiberglass & Reinforcement Preparation
elyaf.desc: Polgün prepares the fiberglass fabrics and reinforcement materials used in composite production to exact dimensions using CNC automated cutting systems. Operating on digital CAD data, parts matching diverse product geometries are cut with speed, repeatability, and precision. This technology minimizes material waste, enhances cutting accuracy, and significantly shortens manufacturing lead times, supporting consistent quality across composite processes.

kompozit.title: Composite Production & RTM Technology
kompozit.desc: Polgün manufactures composite components for water slides and park attractions in-house utilizing methods such as RTM, L-RTM, hand lay-up, and spray-up. Durable and repeatable parts are crafted using resin, reinforcement, and layup schedules tailored to product geometry and performance demands. Subsequent gelcoat application, surface leveling, pigmentation, buffing, and topcoating ensure impeccable visual integrity and surface excellence.

çelik_işleme.title: Steel Processing & Cutting Technologies
çelik_işleme.desc: Polgün accurately transfers designs to fabrication utilizing high-precision steel cutting and machining technologies. CNC pipe and profile cutting systems prepare structural components of varying diameters, cross-sections, and geometries with tight dimensional accuracy. Direct transfer of digital CAD data facilitates faster, repeatable production of support structures matching intricate slide paths, strengthening overall quality control.

çelik_konstrüksiyon.title: Steel Construction & Welded Fabrication
çelik_konstrüksiyon.desc: Polgün manufactures the structural steel systems for water slides and parks entirely in-house. CNC-processed pipes, profiles, and structural members are assembled with precision welding and fabrication according to project-specific geometry. Fully integrated execution from cutting to welding ensures strict dimensional fidelity, structural integrity, and architectural flexibility tailored to each installation.

mekanik.title: Mechanical Machining & Parts Fabrication
mekanik.desc: Polgün produces custom fasteners, flanges, and specialized mechanical components used across water slide systems and steel frameworks in-house. Components are machined to precise engineering tolerances to guarantee perfect on-site fit. Our in-house machining capability provides dimensional accuracy, repeatable quality, and rapid project adaptation for non-standard technical requirements.

boya.title: Painting & Protective Coating Applications
boya.desc: Polgün executes surface preparation, industrial painting, and protective coating operations for steel structures and metal components in-house according to operational environments. Applied systems safeguard metal surfaces against corrosion, UV, and harsh chemical exposures while delivering flawless aesthetics and lasting durability across varying climatic conditions.

kalite.title: Final Inspection & Product Protection
kalite.desc: Finished composite components at Polgün undergo rigorous surface finish, thickness, and structural integrity inspections before advancing to dispatch. Protective wrapping and handling procedures are strictly applied to preserve product surfaces during manufacturing, transit, and assembly, safeguarding premium quality from factory floor to job site.

paketleme.title: Packaging & Logistics Dispatch
paketleme.desc: To deliver inspected products securely to job sites worldwide, Polgün implements tailored packaging and container loading protocols suited to each product type and transport route. Composite panels, steel frames, and hardware kits are secured against transit damage, ensuring coordinated, prompt, and intact global site delivery.

mugla.label: Headquarters Production Facility
mugla.desc: Main production and R&D center. The central facility houses steel construction, composite production, and digital manufacturing infrastructure.

bursa.label: Bursa Production Facility
bursa.desc: Polgün's northern production center. The facility handles steel parts fabrication and semi-finished product manufacturing.

istanbul.label: Marmara Technopark
istanbul.desc: Marmara Technopark office where R&D and innovation studies are conducted. New product development and technical analysis center.

about.story_desc1: 1985 年创立于土耳其穆拉，Polgün 从高性能复合材料制造起步，逐步成长为享誉全球的水上乐园设计与建造专家。
about.story_desc2: 我们在水动力学仿真、游客安全保障及绿色环保生产方面精益求精，致力于为全球家庭带来安全与欢乐。
about.value1_desc: 坚守全球最严苛的安全标准（EN 1069, ASTM, ISO）。
about.value2_desc: 持续研发颠覆性的滑梯几何构型与沉浸式声光电游乐系统。
about.value3_desc: 采用国际顶级原料与尖端 RTM 制造工艺，确保极长使用寿命。
about.value4_desc: 提供从概念设计到终身维护的全程贴心陪伴。
about.values_desc: 指引我们在全球每一个项目中追求卓越的核心准则。

services.subtitle: Holistic Project Management
services.desc: Polgün provides high-standard and professional services at every stage of waterpark projects. Managing all processes from planning to design, engineering to installation with its expert staff, it delivers turnkey projects.
services.process_title: We are with you every step of the way, from start to finish
services.cta_desc: No matter the project size, we are with you from day one to the final day.

service.title: Full Service
service.desc: From design to assembly, maintenance to software at every step.

countries.desc: Global project experience and local expertise.

step1.title: Product Design & Theming
step1.desc: Water slides, children's play groups, and waterpark attractions are custom designed according to the project concept and customer expectations. Color, pattern, theme, and visual details are developed in harmony with product geometry to create unique designs that enhance the visitor experience.

step2.title: Engineering & Projecting
step2.desc: Slide systems, steel support structures, mechanical and hydraulic infrastructures are engineered in detail by our technical teams. Structural calculations, technical analyses, manufacturing drawings, and assembly documentation are prepared according to project conditions.

step3.title: Production
step3.desc: Fiberglass slide components, steel structures, models, molds, and project-specific parts are manufactured in Polgün’s advanced facilities based on strict dimensional accuracy, surface finish, durability, and full traceability.

step4.title: Project Management & Shipping
step4.desc: Design, manufacturing, packaging, logistics, and site schedules are seamlessly coordinated. Products are labeled with an accurate coding system, packed securely, and delivered completely to the project site.

step5.title: Installation & Commissioning
step5.desc: Slides, steel frames, and related equipment are installed by experienced site teams or under Polgün technical supervision. Connections, sliding surfaces, water flow, and system functions are thoroughly verified and commissioned.

planlama.title: Planning
planlama.desc: The success of every waterpark project begins with accurate planning. Analyzing the investor's budget, land topography, target audience, and market dynamics, the most suitable layout and concept are crafted.

tasarim.title: Design
tasarim.desc: We create exciting waterpark concepts with innovative and unique designs. Utilizing 3D modeling technologies, we present the project's completed look in the most realistic way possible.

muhendislik.title: Engineering
muhendislik.desc: We engineer safe and durable structures compliant with international standards. Through structural analysis of steel frames and GRP (fiberglass) parts, we ensure the highest safety and quality standards.

montaj.title: Installation & Assembly
montaj.desc: With expert assembly crews and site supervisors, we complete on-site installations swiftly and seamlessly, strictly adhering to occupational health and safety standards.

bakim.title: Maintenance & Repair
bakim.desc: We offer regular maintenance services to ensure long-lasting and safe waterpark operations. Through pre-season inspections, spare parts supply, and technical assistance, we ensure uninterrupted fun.

yenileme.title: Renovation
yenileme.desc: We modernize existing waterparks with state-of-the-art technologies and trending designs. Adding new slide attractions, kids' play zones, and themed elements, we rejuvenate the park's appeal.

products.title: Our Products
products.subtitle: Innovative & Safe Water Play Systems
products.desc: Discover our product range combining aesthetics, excitement, and the highest safety standards.

slides.title: Water Slides
slides.desc: Our open and closed tube water slides offering speed, excitement, and adrenaline together, suitable for all age groups.

tower.title: Splash Tower
tower.desc: Interactive water play towers designed in different themes, where children and families can safely spend time.

zone.title: Splash Zone
zone.desc: Areas where kids meet water safely with sprayers, water guns, and small play elements.

pirate_theme.desc: Polgün's signature theme, the Pirate Theme, is designed for children to sail in open seas full of pirates and have fun in this imaginary world.

underwater_theme.desc: An interactive playground designed based on colorful corals and different species waiting to be discovered, sparking children's curiosity about the underwater world.

navatu.sub: IAAPA Brass Ring Award-Winning Wave System
navatu.desc: Navatu is an innovative waterpark system developed at Polgün's R&D Center and awarded the Brass Ring award at IAAPA Expo Orlando. It takes the natural wave experience to a new dimension.

savana.desc: An innovative R&D project that combines four different slide paths in a single body. Savana offers its users a unique visual feast and sliding experience.

big_hole.desc: Big Hole is a large-scale enclosed water slide designed to offer a shared family rafting experience. Its wide-section tube structure delivers an impressive sense of speed and movement, turning the classic enclosed slide concept into a fun, social, and unforgettable family adventure.

big_raft.desc: Big Raft is a wide and comfortable family slide designed for shared use. Thanks to its wide sliding surface, families and groups of friends can experience speed and excitement together, combining social interaction with a delightful waterpark experience.

family_slide.desc: Family Slide is a multi-person raft slide designed for families and groups to enjoy together. With its wide turns, smooth transitions, and rafts accommodating up to four people, it offers interactive fun and high-capacity entertainment.

family_tornado.desc: Family Tornado brings the iconic funnel experience on a larger scale, allowing larger groups to experience the thrill together. Its wide funnel structure and strong oscillation movement offer high acceleration and an instantaneous feeling of weightlessness.

mid_hole.desc: Mid Hole is an enclosed family-type water slide offering a wide and impressive riding experience. The enclosed tube design increases the sense of mystery and excitement throughout the journey, providing a comfortable and shared sliding experience.

ufo_slide.desc: UFO Slide is a family-friendly raft water slide inspired by its unique elliptical form. The enclosed tube structure offers a smooth and comfortable slide for up to four riders, combining shared fun with high entertainment value.

freefall.desc: Freefall is a high-adrenaline water slide designed to deliver the intense sensation of free fall. With its nearly vertical drop angle and continuous high-speed track, it offers a short but extremely impressive sliding experience.

hydro_river.desc: Hydro River is an action-packed water slide that simulates a wild river adventure. Combining high-speed water currents, sharp turns, and sudden drops, it provides an exhilarating rafting experience for thrill-seekers.

rocket_slide.desc: Rocket Slide is a high-speed capsule slide that launches riders with a trapdoor start. Delivering maximum acceleration and speed, it offers a thrilling gravity-defying ride for adrenaline lovers.

uphill_slide.desc: Uphill Slide uses advanced water propulsion technology to push riders uphill against gravity. With its dynamic roller-coaster-like ups and downs, it delivers an innovative and exciting slide experience.

kamikaze.desc: Kamikaze is a classic high-speed speed slide offering multiple drops and intense acceleration. Designed for thrill-seekers, it provides an adrenaline-pumping sliding experience with a clear view of the descent.

babochka.desc: Babochka is a double-wing butterfly slide offering high-speed drops and bidirectional sliding action. With its unique wing-like geometry, it delivers a thrilling oscillation experience for riders.

boomerango.desc: Boomerango is a high-thrill slide that drops riders down a steep launch path before sending them high up a vertical wall. After experiencing temporary weightlessness at the peak, riders slide backward into a splash pool.

drone.desc: Drone Slide features a futuristic, enclosed design that combines light effects and sharp curves. It offers an interactive and mysterious journey, simulating a high-tech drone flight.

magic_tray.desc: Magic Tray is a wide-section circular bowl slide that spins riders around its perimeter before dropping them through the center hole into a splash pool below.

mini_boomerango.desc: Mini Boomerango brings the popular vertical wall experience on a smaller scale, making it accessible and fun for younger adventurers and families.

space_rocket.desc: Space Rocket is a high-speed slide featuring a launch capsule and a loop path, delivering high G-forces and maximum thrill for extreme sports enthusiasts.

super_bowl.desc: Super Bowl spins riders around a massive circular bowl before dropping them through a central exit, creating a suspenseful and highly entertaining slide experience.

space_bowl.desc: Space Bowl combines an enclosed tube entry with a giant open bowl spin, offering a thrilling combination of speed and centrifugal force.

tornado_slide.desc: Tornado Slide features a massive funnel that sucks rafts in, tossing them from side to side in a high-speed spiral before exiting into the splash pool.

planeta.desc: Planeta is a themed multi-sensory slide combining visual projections, sound effects, and unique slide paths to create an out-of-this-world journey.

body_racer.desc: Body Racer is a head-first mat racing slide with side-by-side lanes, allowing friends and family to compete in a high-speed dash to the finish line.

multi_slide.desc: Multi Slide features multiple parallel lanes for side-by-side racing, offering high capacity and competitive fun for waterpark visitors.

twister_slide.desc: Twister Slide consists of interlocking, twisting tubes that create a dizzying and fast-paced sliding experience.

racer_slide.desc: Racer Slide is a competitive racing slide featuring enclosed loops and open racing lanes, allowing riders to track their positions throughout the race.

spider_slide.desc: Spider Slide features a multi-legged design with branching slide paths, offering a mysterious and unique descent.

aquatube.desc: Aquatube is a classic high-speed enclosed tube slide, offering a fast and smooth ride in total darkness or with translucent color rings.

black_hole.desc: Black Hole is a popular enclosed slide featuring spectacular light and sound effects inside the dark tube, creating a sensory-rich adventure.

compact_slide.desc: Compact Slide is a space-saving water slide featuring tight curves and quick drops, perfect for smaller parks or hotel pools.

rafting_slide.desc: Rafting Slide offers a classic, moderate-speed open slide experience for single or double rafts, simulating a gentle river rafting trip.

wide_slide.desc: Wide Slide features a broad, open lane that allows multiple riders to slide side-by-side without rafts, offering safe and simple fun for families.

body_slide.desc: Body Slide is a classic open-air body slide featuring smooth curves and gentle drops, providing a fun and relaxing ride for all ages.

slip_fly.desc: Slip & Fly features a ramp at the end of the slide that launches riders into the air before landing in a deep pool. It offers a spectacular, high-action attraction that is as fun to watch as it is to ride.

canyon_slide.desc: Canyon Slide simulates a rafting journey through deep rocky canyons. With its high walls, sudden turns, and varied water flow, it offers an immersive and adventurous sliding experience for all ages.

crazy_cone.desc: Crazy Cone features one or more conical shapes that create sudden swings and directional changes. As rafts enter the cone, they oscillate high on the walls before exiting back into the slide tube.

hill_slide.desc: Hill Slide is a multi-bump slide that simulates a series of small hills, creating exciting airtime moments and speed variations throughout the descent.

hydra_slide.desc: Hydra Slide features a multi-lane design with twisting paths, allowing multiple riders to slide simultaneously and race to the finish line.

arge.title: R&D & Innovation
arge.subtitle: Future Water Entertainment Technologies
arge.desc: As the first approved R&D center in Muğla, Polgün R&D Center designs innovative technologies and products shaping the industry.
arge.section1_desc: Using engineering software, flow analyses, and next-generation production methods, we optimize the performance and durability of our products.
arge.hero_desc: At Polgün Waterparks, the foundation of our R&D approach is to develop safe, innovative, sustainable, and high-value-added water entertainment technologies.
arge.p1: Our center, which gained R&D Center status with Ministerial approval in 2021, pioneers original product development, localization, and technology production in our sector as the first and only R&D Center of Muğla.
arge.p2: In our R&D Center, we manage new product design, engineering analyses, prototyping, testing, validation, production method development, and intellectual property processes in a holistic approach with 30 full-time equivalent qualified R&D personnel working as researchers, technicians, and support staff.
arge.p3: We view nationalization and localization efforts for our country as a strategic responsibility; we develop solutions that reduce external dependency, are rapidly applicable, and directly respond to customer needs. In all our R&D processes from design to production, from analysis to field application, we adhere to the principles of safety, quality, compliance with international standards, and sustainability.
arge.p4: Projects developed at Polgün R&D Center add value to the sector in areas such as water savings, user safety, capacity increase, thematic experience, modular production, composite material technologies, and next-generation water slide geometries. Our innovative product projects such as Navatu, Savana, Monarch Butterfly, and Eclipse are among the important R&D outputs that represent Polgün's design, engineering, and production strength in the international market.
arge.p5: Our R&D activities are not limited to new product development alone. We also carry out continuous development work to improve the performance of existing products, improve production processes, reduce environmental impacts, increase material efficiency, and increase our competitive power in international markets. We strengthen our corporate knowledge base through academic collaborations, scientific publications, patent and design registration processes; and transform the outputs obtained into a sustainable innovation culture.
arge.misyon_desc: To bring unique solutions to the water entertainment industry by developing high-quality, safe, cost-effective, and innovative R&D projects; and to create pioneering products that represent our country in national and international markets. We aim to bring qualified knowledge, technology, and human resources to our sector by adhering to work schedules, engineering verifications, standards compliance, and sustainable production principles in our R&D processes.
arge.vizyon_desc: As Polgün Waterparks R&D Center, our vision is to be a leading and pioneering R&D center that shapes water entertainment technologies with its unique designs, innovative engineering solutions, strong production capability, and projects in compliance with international standards. We aim to become a brand recognized both nationally and internationally with projects we develop without compromising quality.
arge.navatu_desc: An innovative waterpark system that takes the natural wave experience to a new dimension.
arge.savana_desc: An innovative R&D project that combines four different slide paths in a single structure.
arge.monarch_desc: A custom design bringing the aesthetic form of butterfly wings together with water slide geometry, offering a high-speed and double-sided riding experience.
arge.fikri_sinai_desc: Technological innovations and designs developed by Polgün R&D Center are protected by national and international registrations.
arge.brands_desc: Polgün's registered trademarks in Turkey and worldwide embody our unique identity and recognized reliability.

minister.title: We had the honor of hosting our Minister of Industry and Technology, Mr. Mehmet Fatih Kacir, at Polgun Waterparks.
minister.desc:
We were proud to host the delegation accompanied by our Governor of Muğla Mr. Idris Akbiyik, our Muğla Deputies Mr. Kadem Mete and Mr. Yakup Otgöz, District Governor of Menteşe Mr. Mehmet Eriş, AK Party Provincial Chairman Mr. Haluk Laçin, MHP Provincial Chairman Mr. Burak Demirel, and Mayor of Kavaklidere Mr. Mehmet Demir at our factory. The delegation visited our production facility in Muğla and examined our R&D center.

As one of the global leaders in the industry, we take great pride in our commitment to innovation, quality, and excellence. Their visit has once again demonstrated the importance of advanced production technologies and R&D in shaping the future. We express our sincere gratitude to them for their kind visit, interest, and support.

history.title: Our History
history.desc: Over the years, we have continuously grown our manufacturing strength, engineering expertise, and global project experience. Every step we took has been part of a stronger manufacturing infrastructure, innovative products, and the Polgün journey reaching more than 70 countries today.
history.desc1: Polgün continuously carries out infrastructure investments to meet the increasing capacity need and advance its production capabilities; while creating new production areas for polyester, thermoplastic coating, and painting processes in its existing facilities in Muğla, it consolidates its growing operational power on an international scale by reaching a total of 120,000 m² production area with the new factory investment in Bursa.
history.desc2: In order to carry R&D and Design competence even further, the application process for the Marmara Teknokent office has been completed and the contract has been signed, officializing the structure. This setup aims to strengthen university collaborations.
history.bold_summary: Today, Polgün strengthens its position in the international market with its manufacturing setup in Turkey and sales office in Spain.

gunes_bakim_evi.title: Special Güneş Day Care Center Opening
gunes_bakim_evi.desc: Our support for social responsibility projects continues uninterrupted. The opening of the Special Güneş Day Care Center, implemented by Menteşe Municipality, was held with the participation of our General Manager, Mr. Ibrahim Güngör. As the Polgün Family, we are happy to touch little hearts today as well.

aile_sosyal_hizmetler.title: Collaboration with Family and Social Services Directorate
aile_sosyal_hizmetler.desc: As the Polgün family, we are happy to support a meaningful work carried out by the Muğla Provincial Directorate of Family and Social Services. Thanks to this cooperation, which was initiated through our Governor Idris Akbiyik, warmer and safer living spaces are created for children. We believe in the power of social solidarity and adopt the importance of such contributions in every step looking to the future with hope.

iftar_programi.title: Our Traditional Iftar Invitation
iftar_programi.desc: Our traditional iftar invitation, honored by our Muğla Governor Mr. Idris Akbiyik, Menteşe District Governor Mr. Mehmet Eriş, MSKÜ Rector Prof. Dr. Turhan Kaçar, Yatağan Mayor Mr. Mesut Günay, 27th Term Muğla Deputy Mrs. Yelda Erol, TÜBITAK MARTEK President and 24th Term Deputy Mr. Mehmet Ali Okur, valuable businesspeople of Muğla, political party representatives and our big Polgün family, took place on March 14, 2026, at Türkan Saylan Education and Culture Center with the participation of more than 600 guests. In the iftar program organized by Polgün Waterparks & Attractions Chairman of the Board Ibrahim Güngör and his precious family, accompanied by hymns sung by Turkish Sufi Music artist Abdurrahman Önül, Enes Çiftçi's presentation and semazen show attracted great attention. We extend our thanks to all our family members who attended and honored our invitation.

msku_kariyer_fuari.title: MSKÜ Career Fair
msku_kariyer_fuari.desc: Polgün Waterparks & Attractions Chairman of the Board Mr. Ibrahim Güngör met with the professionals of the future at the Career Fair organized at Muğla Sitki Koçman University. Sharing his knowledge and experience in the sector with young talents, Ibrahim Güngör held an inspiring conversation with students on the dynamics of the water park and entertainment sector, our innovative projects, and career planning. The excitement and vision of the youth who will shape the future of our industry once again became a great source of motivation for us. As the Polgün family, we are proud to stand by young talents and support them in their career journeys!

splashtower.title: Splash Tower
splashtower.subtitle: Fun Water Play Towers
splashtower.desc: Safe and thematic interactive adventure areas where children meet water.

pirate.name: Pirate Theme
pirate.desc: Designed as Polgün's signature theme and favored by many water parks, the Pirate Theme allows children to sail into open seas full of pirates and have fun in this imaginary world. Fully customizable in any size and desired color option, the Pirate Theme features giant parrots, an iconic shark, interactive water plays, palm trees, and a giant water bucket with a pirate head. When you see adults having as much fun as the little guests, choosing Polgün's Pirate Theme for your water park will be inevitable.

jungle.name: Jungle Theme
jungle.desc: Step into the wild with the Polgün Jungle Splash Tower, a themed water playground inspired by the beauty, energy, and mystery of tropical rainforests. Brought to life with forest characters that spark the imagination such as elephants, parrots, owls, squirrels, and giant trees, this theme creates an exciting environment where children can explore, play, and unleash their creativity. Nature-inspired details, interactive water features, and adventurous decorative elements turn the playground into a vivid jungle journey. Designed with earth tones, wood-look surfaces, and rich nature-themed graphics, the Jungle Splash Tower offers a unique visual identity for water parks, resorts, and family entertainment centers. With its fully customizable structure in terms of size, layout, color palette, and thematic details, it can be tailored to the concept and capacity needs of every project.

custom.name: Custom Theme
custom.desc: At Polgün, every project can be turned into a unique story. Our Custom Theme service combines creative design, conceptual development, and carefully selected color palettes to create water playgrounds that reflect the identity and vision of each venue. Supported by decades of industry experience, an in-house R&D team, and advanced CAD design capabilities, our designers develop original concepts tailored to the requirements of each project. From the initial idea to the final themed entertainment area, every detail is meticulously crafted to offer an engaging, visually stunning, and unforgettable experience for visitors. Whether inspired by nature, fantasy worlds, adventure, or starting from a completely original concept, Polgün produces fully personalized thematic solutions for water parks, resorts, hotels, and family entertainment centers.

underwater.name: Underwater Theme
underwater.desc: Oceans, seas, and the underwater world have always been a mysterious, exciting, and magical world for children.

candy.name: Candy Theme
candy.desc: Inspired by the world of sweets and candies, Candy Theme brings joy to waterparks with its vibrant colors and playful design.

carnaval.name: Carnaval Theme
carnaval.desc: Bring the joyful spirit of the carnival to life with the Polgün Carnival Splash Tower, a lively water playground designed to stimulate children's imagination.

jurassic.name: Jurassic Theme
jurassic.desc: Bring the prehistoric world to life with the Polgün Jurassic Splash Tower, a themed water play area designed to spark curiosity, excitement, and adventure.

galaxy.name: Galaxy Theme
galaxy.desc: Get ready for takeoff with the Polgün Galaxy Splash Tower, a themed water play area designed to take children on an exciting journey through the wonders of the universe.

castle.name: Castle Theme
castle.desc: A medieval aquatic kingdom filled with fairy-tale towers and suspension bridges.
